cases.title: Add new bookmark to specific location in hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark is successfully added and placed into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Verify bookmark deletion from bookmarks file and access points
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are properly deleted from the bookmarks file and are no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark from the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder Into Hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark to launch browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify default bookmarks file links validity
cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser contain valid links.

cases.title: Save changes to a bookmark item
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved.

cases.title: Save bookmark changes without loss of item integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes to a bookmark item are saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add Bookmarks Separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be added successfully.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be deleted successfully.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes are saved over browser restart
cases.description: Make changes to bookmarks and verify that the changes are successfully saved after restarting the browser.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes are saved over browser crash
cases.description: Make changes to bookmarks and verify that the changes are successfully saved after a browser crash event.

cases.title: Negative View Properties Execution for Bookmarks, Folders, and Separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties do not execute successfully for bookmarks, folders, and separators in the negative test scenario.

cases.title: Inline Bookmark Rename
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully found by using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort Bookmarks per Column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns are resizable to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly showed.

cases.title: Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks at One Time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted simultaneously, removing all of them in a single action.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate child.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicit behaviors, boundaries, and distinct scenarios are fully covered by the proposed test cases. There are no missing scenarios or confirmed blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Add new bookmark, 2) Place into a specific location within bookmarks hierarchy. Scenario types: Normal. R-002: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Properly deleted from bookmarks file, 2) No longer displayed from all access points. Scenario types: Normal. R-003: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Added from the personal toolbar, 2) Deleted from the personal toolbar. Scenario types: Normal. R-004: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) New bookmark folder inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy. Scenario types: Normal. R-005: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Double-clicking on a bookmark launches it in a browser window. Scenario types: Normal. R-006: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser are valid links. Scenario types: Normal. R-007: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Changes to a bookmark item saved, 2) Saved without loss of item integrity. Scenario types: Normal. R-008: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks folder deleted. Scenario types: Normal. R-009: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks separators added, 2) Bookmarks separators deleted. Scenario types: Normal. R-010: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks changes saved over restart, 2) Bookmarks changes saved over crash. Scenario types: Normal, Abnormal/Error. R-011: Single straightforward acceptance criterion with negative focus. Atomic behaviors: 1) View properties execute for bookmarks, folders, and separators (negative). Scenario types: Abnormal/Error. R-012: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks renamed inline without using properties dialog. Scenario types: Normal. R-013: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks found using user-defined custom keyword. Scenario types: Normal. R-014: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmarks sorted per column, 2) Bookmarks reverse-sorted per column. Scenario types: Normal. R-015: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmark columns resizable to show/hide more of entries. Scenario types: Normal, Boundary. R-016: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Bookmark columns showed, 2) Bookmark columns hidden. Scenario types: Normal. R-017: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Atomic behaviors: 1) Several bookmarks deleted at one time. Scenario types: Normal. R-018: Multiple behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself, 2) Not possible to drop onto its immediate parent, 3) Not possible to drop onto its immediate child. Scenario types: Abnormal/Error, Boundary.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicit behaviors, boundaries, and distinct scenarios are fully covered by the proposed test cases. There are no missing scenarios or confirmed blockers.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases comprehensively cover all 18 specified requirements (R-001 through R-018) with appropriate granularity. Minor redundancies exist where single requirements are split into multiple cases without adding new observable behaviors (such as G-008 and G-009 for R-007, or G-018 and G-019 for R-014), but these do not constitute excessive overgeneration as they cleanly map to distinct sub-clauses or inverse operations. No significant gaps, overgeneration, or repetition beyond acceptable test coverage were found.
